hebrewText: וַ/תַּ֛עַל אֶחָ֥ד מִ/גֻּרֶ֖י/הָ כְּפִ֣יר הָיָ֑ה וַ/יִּלְמַ֥ד לִ/טְרָף טֶ֖רֶף אָדָ֥ם אָכָֽל

tokens.bdb: to ascend, intransitively (be high) or actively (mount); used in a great variety of senses, primary and secondary, literal and figurative
tokens.kjv: arise (up), (cause to) ascend up, at once, break (the day) (up), bring (up), (cause to) burn, carry up, cast up, [phrase] shew, climb (up), (cause to, make to) come (up), cut off, dawn, depart, exalt, excel, fall, fetch up, get up, (make to) go (away, up); grow (over) increase, lay, leap, levy, lift (self) up, light, (make) up, [idiom] mention, mount up, offer, make to pay, [phrase] perfect, prefer, put (on), raise, recover, restore, (make to) rise (up), scale, set (up), shoot forth (up), (begin to) spring (up), stir up, take away (up), work.

tokens.bdb: properly, united, i.e. one; or (as an ordinal) first
tokens.kjv: a, alike, alone, altogether, and, any(-thing), apiece, a certain, (dai-) ly, each (one), [phrase] eleven, every, few, first, [phrase] highway, a man, once, one, only, other, some, together,

tokens.bdb: a cub (as still abiding in the lair), especially of the lion
a village (as covered in by walls); also a young lion (perhaps as covered with a mane)
tokens.ptLiteralWord: a village ; also a young lion
tokens.enLiteralWord: a village ; also a young lion
tokens.explanation: a village ; also a young lion
tokens.explanationEn: a village ; also a young lion

tokens.bdb: to exist, i.e. be or become, come to pass (always emphatic, and not a mere copula or auxiliary)
tokens.kjv: beacon, [idiom] altogether, be(-come), accomplished, committed, like), break, cause, come (to pass), do, faint, fall, [phrase] follow, happen, [idiom] have, last, pertain, quit (one-) self, require, [idiom] use.

tokens.bdb: properly, to goad, i.e. (by implication) to teach (the rod being an Oriental incentive)
tokens.kjv: (un-) accustomed, [idiom] diligently, expert, instruct, learn, skilful, teach(-er, -ing).

tokens.bdb: to pluck off or pull to pieces; causatively to supply with food (as in morsels)
tokens.kjv: catch, [idiom] without doubt, feed, ravin, rend in pieces, [idiom] surely, tear (in pieces).
tokens.ptLiteralWord: to pluck off or pull to pieces; causatively to supply with food
tokens.enLiteralWord: to pluck off or pull to pieces; causatively to supply with food
tokens.explanation: to pluck off or pull to pieces; causatively to supply with food
tokens.explanationEn: to pluck off or pull to pieces; causatively to supply with food

tokens.bdb: something torn, i.e. a fragment, e.g. a fresh leaf, prey, food
ruddy i.e. a human being (an individual or the species, mankind, etc.)
tokens.kjv: [idiom] another, [phrase] hypocrite, [phrase] common sort, [idiom] low, man (mean, of low degree), person.
tokens.ptLiteralWord: ruddy i.e. a human being (an individual or the species
tokens.enLiteralWord: ruddy i.e. a human being (an individual or the species
tokens.explanation: ruddy i.e. a human being (an individual or the species
tokens.explanationEn: ruddy i.e. a human being (an individual or the species

tokens.kjv: [idiom] at all, burn up, consume, devour(-er, up), dine, eat(-er, up), feed (with), food, [idiom] freely, [idiom] in...wise(-deed, plenty), (lay) meat, [idiom] quite.
